test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: To which Indian state does Madhubani art belong?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Bihar.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The folk art of **Bihar**, usually called as **Madhubani**, mentions to the market town of the same name.
 
• Madhubani paintings **use two-dimensional imagery, and the colors used are derived from plants**.
 
• Ochre, Lampblack, and Red are **used for reddish-brown and black, appropriately.**
 
• Madhubani paintings mainly **depict people and their association** with nature and scenes and deities from the old epics.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a84f7803e8bf8cbfa28cc35425acd64a4b1b6e57448673c58c11b131d075f100.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dokra Metal Craft** is one of the most famous forms of** art practiced in Bengal.**
 
• **Phulkari** is the most famous handiwork in **India (Punjab).**
 
• The **Warli Painting** tradition in **Maharashtra** is among the finest examples of the folk style of paintings.​
